foil.title: Inflation and rates pressure from Eastern Mediterranean maritime disruption state
foil.scenario_short: Inflation and rates pressure from Eastern Mediterranean maritime disruption will persist, driven by 50% energy supply shock pressure and 72% state confirmation, with 3 urgent critical signals.
foil.perspective_strategic: The 50% energy supply shock pressure and 72% state confirmation indicate a moderate inflation risk, but the 30d projection dropping to 27% suggests the disruption may not be sustained.
foil.perspective_contrarian: The 75% confidence level still leaves room for reversal, and the 30d projection of 27% suggests that without new directly matched reporting on Eastern Mediterranean, the inflation path could stabilize as Tehran seeks a negotiated way out with Washington.
foil.actor_lens: Commodity traders: Price whether stress in Eastern Mediterranean becomes durable over the 30d. Rebalance positions if the probability path moves away from 64%.
foil.top_signal: Eastern Mediterranean maritime disruption state is feeding inflation and rates pressure through energy supply shock, with 50% pressure and 72% state confirmation
